                            if timer 'NoTargetTimer' > 5000
                                overhead "[ TARGET ELIMINATED! ]" 2114
                                settimer 'NoTargetTimer' 0
                            endif
                        endif
                    endif
                endif
            endif

            if EnableOverheadMessages = 1
                if insysmsg "something invisible out of"
                    overhead "▼ SOMEONE HIDING! ▼" 6
                endif

                if insysmsg "additional mastery chain link"
                    overhead "[ CHAIN LINK UNLOCKED!! ]" 149
                    wait 500
                    if EnableUseEmotes = 1 and timer EmoteCooldownTimer > SetEmoteCooldown
                        wait 500
                        say "[Yes"
                        settimer EmoteCooldownTimer 0
                        cooldown "Emote Cooldown" SetEmoteCooldown
                    endif
                endif

                if insysmsg "enough experience to upgrade"
                    overhead "[ ASPECT TIER UNLOCKED!! ]" 2234
                    wait 500
                    if EnableUseEmotes = 1 and timer EmoteCooldownTimer > SetEmoteCooldown
                        wait 500
                        say "[Whistle"
                        settimer EmoteCooldownTimer 0
                        cooldown "Emote Cooldown" SetEmoteCooldown
                    endif
                endif

                if insysmsg "You have unlocked a codex upgrade point"
                    overhead "[ CODEX POINT UNLOCKED! ]" 2114
                    wait 250
                    if EnableUseEmotes = 1 and timer EmoteCooldownTimer > SetEmoteCooldown
                        wait 500
                        say "[HighFive"
                        settimer EmoteCooldownTimer 0
                        cooldown "Emote Cooldown" SetEmoteCooldown
                    endif
                endif

                if insysmsg "You have completed a society job"
                    overhead "[ SOCIETY JOB COMPLETE! ]" 419
                    wait 500
                    if EnableUseEmotes = 1 and timer EmoteCooldownTimer > SetEmoteCooldown
                        wait 500
                        say "[Awoo"
                        settimer EmoteCooldownTimer 0
                        cooldown "Emote Cooldown" SetEmoteCooldown
                    endif
                endif

                if insysmsg "Society Job Progress"
                    overhead "[ ▲ SOCIETY POINTS ▲ ]" 419
                endif

                if insysmsg "attempting to steal" or insysmsg "attempting to peek"
                    overhead "[ THIEF DETECTED! ]" 910
                endif
            else
                if insysmsg "something invisible out of"
                    overhead "▼ SOMEONE HIDING! ▼" 6
                endif

                if insysmsg "additional mastery chain link"
                    overhead "[ ▲ CHAIN! ▲ ]" 149
                    wait 500
                    if EnableUseEmotes = 1 and timer EmoteCooldownTimer > SetEmoteCooldown
                        wait 500
                        say "[Yes"
                        settimer EmoteCooldownTimer 0
                        cooldown "Emote Cooldown" SetEmoteCooldown
                    endif
                endif

                if insysmsg "enough experience to upgrade"
                    overhead "[ ▲ ASPECT ▲ ]" 2234
                    wait 500
                    if EnableUseEmotes = 1 and timer EmoteCooldownTimer > SetEmoteCooldown
                        wait 500
                        say "[Whistle"
                        settimer EmoteCooldownTimer 0
                        cooldown "Emote Cooldown" SetEmoteCooldown
                    endif
                endif

                if insysmsg "You have unlocked a codex upgrade point"
                    overhead '[ ▲ CODEX! ▲ ]' 2114
                    wait 250
                    if EnableUseEmotes = 1 and timer EmoteCooldownTimer > SetEmoteCooldown
                        wait 500
                        say "[HighFive"
                        settimer EmoteCooldownTimer 0
                        cooldown "Emote Cooldown" SetEmoteCooldown
                    endif
                endif

                if insysmsg "You have completed a society job"
                    overhead "[ SOCIETY COMPLETE! ]" 419
                    wait 500
                    if EnableUseEmotes = 1 and timer EmoteCooldownTimer > SetEmoteCooldown
                        wait 500
                        say "[Awoo"
                        settimer EmoteCooldownTimer 0
                        cooldown "Emote Cooldown" SetEmoteCooldown
                    endif
                endif

                if insysmsg "Society Job Progress"
                    overhead "[ ▲ SOCIETY ▲ ]" 419
                endif

                if insysmsg "attempting to steal" or insysmsg "attempting to peek"
                    overhead "[ THIEF DETECTED! ]" 910
                endif
            endif

            if EnableAutoCarving = 1 and findtype 11552 self
                while findtype "corpse" ground -1 -1 2 as deadbody and diffhits < CastGreaterHealHPdiff
                    settimer SkinningTimeoutTimer 0
                    if findtype 11552 self
                        if targetexists
                            hotkey 'cancel current target'
                        endif

                        while not targetexists
                            skill 'forensicevaluation'
                            getlabel backpack backpacklabel
                        endwhile

                        clearsysmsg

                        if targetexists and find deadbody ground -1 -1 2
                            target 'self'
                            @ignore deadbody
                            wait 250
                        endif

                        if insysmsg "You dont see anything nearby"
                            clearsysmsg
                            break
                        else
                            if EnableOverheadMessages = 1 and timer SkinningTimer > 3000
                                overhead '[ SKINNING... ]' 333
                                settimer SkinningTimer 0
                            endif
                            break
                        endif
                    else
                        if EnableOverheadMessages = 1 and timer SkinningTimer > 15000
                            overhead '[ NO SKINNING KNIFE ]' 337
                            settimer SkinningTimer 0
                            break
                        endif
                    endif

                    if timer SkinningTimeoutTimer > 1500 or diffhits > CastGreaterHealHPdiff
                        break
                    endif
                endwhile
            endif

            if EnableHealPotion = 1 and diffhits >= HealPotionHPdiff
                if findtype "Yellow Potion" self as HealPot
                    getlabel HealPot HealPotlabel
                    if "next" in HealPotlabel
                        // Do nothing
                    else
                        @setvar! HealPotionCheck 0

                        if counttype 3852 self as HealPotCount
                            @setvar! HealPotionCheck HealPotCount
                        endif
                        clearsysmsg
                        dclicktype 3852
                        getlabel backpack backpackdesc
                        wait 250
                        if insysmsg "potion satchel used"
                            settimer 'HealPotionTimer' 0
                            cooldown "Healing Potion" HealingPotionCooldown
                            if EnableOverheadMessages = 1 and timer 'HealPotionMessageTimer' > 4500
                                overhead '[ FREE HEAL POTION ]' 253
                            endif
                        elseif HealPotionCheck != counttype 3852 self
                            settimer 'HealPotionTimer' 0
                            cooldown "Healing Potion" HealingPotionCooldown
                            if EnableOverheadMessages = 1 and timer 'HealPotionMessageTimer' > 4500
                                overhead '[ HEAL POTION ]' 253
                            endif
                        endif
                        clearsysmsg
                    endif
                else
                    if timer 'HealPotionMessageTimer' > 4500 and EnableOverheadMessages = 1
                        overhead '[ NO HEAL POTS! ]' 337
                        settimer 'HealPotionMessageTimer' 0
                    endif
                endif
            endif

            if skill 'healing' > 0 and hp < maxhp and not bandaging
                if findtype 'clean bandage%s%' self
                    hotkey 'Bandage Self'
                    if EnableOverheadMessages = 1
                        overhead '[ BANDAGING... ]' 88
                    endif
                else
                    if EnableOverheadMessages = 1
                        overhead '[ NO BANDAGES! ]' 337
                    endif
                endif
            endif

            if not findtype "3972" self or not findtype "3962" self or not findtype "3963" self or not findtype "3980" self or not findtype "3976" self or not findtype "3973" self or not findtype "3974" self or not findtype "3981" self
                clearignore
                getlabel backpack backpacklabel
                if not findtype "3972" self or not findtype "3962" self or not findtype "3963" self or not findtype "3980" self or not findtype "3976" self or not findtype "3973" self or not findtype "3974" self or not findtype "3981" self
                    if EnableOverheadMessages = 1 or EnableOverheadMessages = 2
                        if timer MissingRegsTimer > 5000
                            if counttype "3972" self = 0
                                overhead '[ NO GARLIC ]' 646
                            endif
                            if counttype "3962" self = 0
                                overhead '[ NO BLACK PEARL ]' 3
                            endif
                            if counttype "3963" self = 0
                                overhead '[ NO BLOODMOSS ]' 33
                            endif
                            if counttype "3980" self = 0
                                overhead '[ NO SULFUROUS ASH ]' 153
                            endif
                            if counttype "3976" self = 0
                                overhead '[ NO NIGHTSHADE ]' 363
                            endif
                            if counttype "3973" self = 0
                                overhead '[ NO GINSENG ]' 247
                            endif
                            if counttype "3974" self = 0
                                overhead '[ NO MANDRAKE ROOT ]' 442
                            endif
                            if counttype "3981" self = 0
                                overhead '[ NO SPIDERS SILK ]' 2338
                            endif
                            settimer MissingRegsTimer 0
                        endif
                    endif
                    @setvar! MissingRegs 1
                else
                    @setvar! MissingRegs 0
                endif
            else
                @setvar! MissingRegs 0
            endif

            if not findtype 3972 self or not findtype 3973 self or not findtype 3974 self or not findtype 3981 self
                @setvar! missingGreaterHealRegs 1
                getlabel backpack backpacklabel
            else
                @setvar! missingGreaterHealRegs 0
            endif

            if not findtype 3972 self or not findtype 3973 self or not findtype 3974 self
                @setvar! missingHealRegs 1
                getlabel backpack backpacklabel
            else
                @setvar! missingHealRegs 0
            endif

            if missingGreaterHealRegs = 1 or missingHealRegs = 1
                if timer NoHealRegsTimer > 4000
                    overhead '[ MISSING HEALING REGS! ]' 337
                    settimer NoHealRegsTimer 0
                endif
            endif

            @setvar! SpellInterrupted 0
            clearsysmsg

            if skill 'magery' >= 60 and diffhits >= CastGreaterHealHPdiff and diffhits <= CastHealHPdiff and mana >= 11 and EnableCastGreaterHeal = 1 and not casting and missingGreaterHealRegs != 1
                @setvar! SpellInterrupted 0
                cast 'greater heal'
                getlabel backpack backpacklabel
                settimer spellTimer 0
                @setvar! spellCD 2500
                while not targetexists and timer spellTimer < spellCD
                    if insysmsg "Your concentration is disturbed"
                        interrupt
                        @setvar! SpellInterrupted 1
                        break
                    endif
                    if timer spellTimer > spellCD
                        break
                    endif
                endwhile
                if SpellInterrupted = 0
                    target 'self'
                endif
            elseif skill 'magery' >= 40 and diffhits >= CastHealHPdiff and diffhits < CastEmergencyHealHPdiff and mana >= 4 and EnableCastHeal = 1 and not casting and missingHealRegs != 1
                @setvar! SpellInterrupted 0
                cast 'heal'
                getlabel backpack backpacklabel
                settimer AntiStallTimer 0
                while not targetexists and timer AntiStallTimer < 1500
                    if insysmsg "Your concentration is disturbed"
                        interrupt
                        @setvar! SpellInterrupted 1
                        break
                    endif
                    if timer AntiStallTimer > 1500
                        settimer AntiStallTimer 0
                        break
                    endif
                endwhile
                if SpellInterrupted = 0
                    target 'self'
                endif
            elseif skill 'magery' >= 40 and diffhits >= CastEmergencyHealHPdiff and mana >= 4 and EnableCastHeal = 1 and not casting and missingHealRegs != 1
                while diffhits > CastGreaterHealHPdiff and mana >= 4 and findtype 3972 self and findtype 3973 self and findtype 3974 self and not dead
                    if targetexists
                        hotkey 'Cancel current target'
                    endif
                    @setvar! SpellInterrupted 0
                    cast 'heal'
                    getlabel backpack backpacklabel
                    settimer AntiStallTimer 0
                    while not targetexists and timer AntiStallTimer < 1500
                        if insysmsg "Your concentration is disturbed"
                            interrupt
                            @setvar! SpellInterrupted 1
                            break
                        endif
                        if timer AntiStallTimer > 1500
                            settimer AntiStallTimer 0
                            break
                        endif
                    endwhile
                    if SpellInterrupted = 0
                        target 'self'
                        getlabel backpack backpacklabel
                    endif
                    if diffhits <= CastGreaterHealHPdiff
                        break
                    endif
                endwhile
            endif

            @setvar! SpellInterrupted 0

            if paralyzed and EnableAutoParalyzePouch = 1
                if findtype "pouch" self
                    yell "[pouch"
                    wait 250
                else
                    if timer PopPouchMessageTimer > 5000 and EnableOverheadMessages = 1
                        overhead '[ NO MORE POUCHES! ]' 337
                        settimer PopPouchMessageTimer 0
                    endif
                endif
            endif

            if EnablePanaceaPotion = 1 and skill 'Alchemy' >= 80
                if findbuff "Bleed" or findbuff "Diseased"
                    if not findbuff "panacea potion cooldown"
                        if findtype "Orange Potion" self
                            dclicktype "Orange Potion"
                            wait 250
                            if findbuff "panacea potion cooldown" and EnableOverheadMessages = 1
                                overhead '[ PANACEA ACTIVATED ]' 55
                                cooldown "Panacea Potion" 30000
                            endif
                        endif
                    endif
                endif
            endif

            if EnableCleansingBrews = 1
                if findbuff "Diseased" or findbuff "Bleed"
                    if timer CleansingBrewTimer > 120000
                        if findtype 50675 self 2935 as CleansingBrew
                            dclick CleansingBrew
                            if EnableOverheadMessages = 1
                                overhead '[ CLEANSING BREW ]' 2117
                            endif
                            cooldown 'Cleansing Brew' 120000
                            settimer CleansingBrewTimer 0
                            wait 250
                        else
                            if timer CleansingBrewOverhead > 15000
                                overhead "[ NO CLEANSING BREWS! ]" 337
                                settimer CleansingBrewOverhead 0
                                settimer CleansingBrewTimer 0
                            endif
                        endif
                    else
                        if EnableOverheadMessages = 1 and timer CleansingBrewOverhead > 15000
                            overhead '[ BREW ON COOLDOWN! ]' 37
                            settimer CleansingBrewOverhead 0
                        endif
                    endif
                endif
            endif

            if EnableCurePotion = 1 or EnableCastCure = 1
                while poisoned
                    if findtype "Orange Potion" self and EnableCurePotion = 1
                        dclicktype "Orange Potion"
                        if EnableOverheadMessages = 1 and timer 'CurePotionMessageTimer' > 3500
                            if insysmsg "potion satchel used"
                                overhead '[ FREE CURE POTION ]' 44
                            else
                                overhead '[ CURE POTION ]' 44
                            endif
                            clearsysmsg
                            settimer 'CurePotionMessageTimer' 0
                        endif
                        wait 500
                    else
                        if timer 'CurePotionMessageTimer' > 5000 and EnableOverheadMessages = 1
                            overhead '[ NO CURE POTS! ]' 337
                            settimer 'CurePotionMessageTimer' 0
                        endif
                        if diffhits >= 30 or not findtype 3972 self or not findtype 3973 self
                            break
                        endif
                        if skill 'magery' >= 40 and mana >= 6 and EnableCastCure = 1 and not casting
                            cast 'cure'
                            getlabel backpack backpacklabel
                            settimer AntiStallTimer 0
                            while not targetexists and timer AntiStallTimer < 1500
                                if timer AntiStallTimer > 1500
                                    settimer AntiStallTimer 0
                                    break
                                endif
                                wait 100
                            endwhile
                            wft 1000
                            target 'self'
                            wait 500
                        else
                            break
                        endif
                    endif
                endwhile
            endif

            if insysmsg "Mana Thief activated"
                if EnableOverheadMessages != 0
                    overhead "[ MANA THIEF! ]" 22
                endif
                cooldown "Mana Thief" 60000
            endif

            if EnableEatHealSnacks = 1
                if skill 'Cooking' >= 50 and timer 'EatHealSnackCooldownTimer' > EatHealSnackCooldown and timer 'HealPotionTimer' < 10500 and diffhits > EatSnackHPdiff
                    if findtype "29774|28883|28885|28880|28879|28888|28886|29773|28881" backpack as myhpsnack
                        if EnableOverheadMessages = 1
                            overhead "[ HP MUNCHING... ]" 420
                        endif
                        dclick myhpsnack
                        wait 250
                        settimer 'EatHealSnackCooldownTimer' 0
                        settimer 'EatManaSnackCooldownTimer' 0
                        cooldown 'Snacking' EatHealSnackCooldown
                    else
                        if timer FoodMessageTimer > 15000 and EnableOverheadMessages = 1
                            overhead "[ NO MORE FOOD! ]" 337
                            settimer FoodMessageTimer 0
                        endif
                    endif
                endif
            endif

            if targetexists
                if findtype " Elven Spellblade" self
                    targettype "Elven Spellblade"
                else
                    target backpack
                endif
            endif

            if not warmode and WarModeToggledWhileFighting = 1
                hotkey 'Toggle War Only'
                @setvar! WarModeToggledWhileFighting 0
            endif

            clearsysmsg
            hotkey 'target closest grey monster'
            wait 250
            @setvar! TargetToAnalyze lasttarget

            if insysmsg 'No one matching that'
                @setvar! AttackModeActive 0
                @setvar! TargetToAnalyze 0
            else
                @setvar! TargetToAnalyze lasttarget
                @setvar! AttackModeActive 2
            endif
        endif
    endif

    if dead
        break
    endif
endwhile


//////////////////////
//  END ALIVE LOOP  //
//////////////////////


/////////////////////////
//  BEGIN DEATH LOOP:  //
/////////////////////////

if dead
    if EnableOverheadMessages = 1 or EnableOverheadMessages = 2
        overhead '[ R.I.P. ]' 337
    endif
    wait 1500

    while dead
        if insysmsg "world is saving"
            settimer "WorldSaveTimer" 0
            if EnableOverheadMessages = 1
                overhead '[ WORLD SAVING... ]' 253
            endif
            while timer "WorldSaveTimer" < 4500
                if insysmsg "save complete"
                    clearsysmsg
                    break
                endif
                wait 100
            endwhile
            if EnableOverheadMessages = 1
                overhead '[ SAVE COMPLETE! ]' 253
            endif
        endif

        @setvar! IHAVEDIED 1
        wait 500
        if timer "WaitingForHealerTimer" > 4000
            overhead '[ FIND A HEALER! ]' 0
            settimer "WaitingForHealerTimer" 0
        endif

        if findtype "blue moongate|30528|moongate" ground -1 -1 15 as EscapeGate
            if timer "GateIndicatorTimer" > 2000
                overhead " ▼ " 253 EscapeGate
                settimer "GateIndicatorTimer" 0
            endif
        endif

        while not gumpexists 3773199800 and findtype "blue moongate|30528|moongate" ground 0 1 2 as EscapeGate
            dclick EscapeGate
            wait 500
        endwhile

        while gumpexists 3773199800
            gumpresponse 16
            wait 500
            waitforgump 3773199800
            gumpresponse 2
            overhead '[ GATING TO TOWN... ]' 88
            break
        endwhile

        while gumpexists 2957810225
            overhead '[ HEALED! ]' 84
            gumpresponse 1
            wait 1000
            gumpclose 2957810225

            if EnableDressAfterResurrection = 1
                overhead '[ DRESSING... ]' 22
                wait 500
                dress 'UltimateArcaneMage'
                wait 500
                while queued
                    wait 100
                endwhile
                dress 'UltimateArcaneMage'
                wait 500
                while queued
                    wait 100
                endwhile
                dress 'UltimateArcaneMage'
                wait 500
            endif

            if EnableRecallAfterResurrection = 1
                hotkey 'Toggle Peace Only'
                @setvar! ResThenTimeToGo 1
                @setvar! WarModeToggledWhileFighting 0
                wait 500
                replay
            else
                wait 2500
                overhead '[ STOPPING SCRIPT! ]' 88
                stop
            endif
        endwhile
    endwhile
endif

replay

//////////////////////
//  END DEATH LOOP  //
//////////////////////



                                                                                #############################
                                                                               ###    SCRIPT ENDS HERE!    ###
                                                                                #############################

scripts.description:
====================================================
Lord Glacier’s Chill: Summoner Auto Pilot Script
====================================================

Take full control of your Summoner Mage with Lord Glacier’s Chill:  Summoner Auto Pilot Script, a fully automated Razor script built exclusively for UO Outlands. Designed for survival, efficiency, and power, this script intelligently manages combat, healing, utility, PK escape, resurrection routines, and more — all while adapting to DUNGEON and/or WILDERNESS scenarios.  Optimized for use on handheld devices such as the Asus ROG Ally (what I personally use to play Outlands).

Whether you're grinding Aspect XP, looting with surgical precision, or dodging reds, this script handles it all. Includes features like auto spellcasting and buffs, potion logic, auto recall or dungeon escape routes, inventory resets after death, automatic gear activation, and more!  Compiled with care by DanStock (aka Lord Glacier), and battle-tested across countless hours of gameplay.  Clean, modular, and highly effective!

FEATURES:
- Smart combat rotations with customizable offensive spells
- Auto-cast, auto-potion, and emergency healing support
- Automatic Recall / Gate escape system when PKs or weight thresholds are triggered
- Death detection and full resurrection recovery loop
- Optional inventory reset and pouch stacking logic after death
- Optional loot bag + chest handling using Organizer Agents
- Optional overhead messages and alternative streamlined version

#       IMPT! (IF USING AUTO RECALL): FIRST RUN OF SCRIPT SHOULD BE DONE IN HOUSE/INN ROOM AND TAKES ROUGHLY 15 SECONDS TO COMPLETE INITIAL (ONE TIME) SETUP!
#           Initial setup can be redone by setting 'ResetScriptPermanentVariables' variable to '1' below!
#           Or you can re-target script variables individually in the 'Options' tab above the script
#
#
#       This script will automatically summon and maintain your SUMMONS based on your variable settings below (up to maximum of 5 control slots)
#       Summons can be either standard elementals or undead summons (based on 'EnableNecroVengefulSpirit' setting below)
#       Script will automatically detect if your summons have died, been dispelled or timed out and will resummon, rename, etc.
#       Summons will GUARD by default, KILL when valid target is within attack range or FOLLOW when DUNGEON ESCAPE is triggered (manual or weight)
#       Running script in WAR MODE will automatically search for and analyze nearby targets and ATTACK if valid target is found within range
#       Targets will be attacked using 'All kill' command -> opening spells -> large damage spells -> medium damage spells -> small damage spells (configure below)
#       Script uses optional BUFFS (during combat) along with POTIONS, BANDAGES and HEALING SPELLS, etc. to keep you alive
#       Running script in PEACE MODE will trigger optional AUTO RECALL (WILDERNESS MODE) or AUTO DUNGEON ESCAPE (DUNGEON MODE) with settings below
#       Using the STATS page in the U.I. or (much easier) the OUTLANDS BUTLER website make sure you are maximizing and reaching your mana refund cap (or other template goals)
#       Recommend use of MEDITATION RATE chain links, DAMAGED TO DISEASED chain links and SPELL ASPECT CHANCE chain links (if going spell-based summoner route)
#       Recommend use of FOLLOWER DAMAGE chain links, FOLLOWER ATTACK SPEED chain links and FOLLOWER DAMAGE RESIST chain links (if going pet-damage summoner route)
#       Eating MUSHROOMS with the Wizards Grimoire will restore MANA (60 second cooldown) if you have 5 points in CREATE FOOD (very important)
#       Otherwise, I would prioritize CURSE, BLESS and PROTECTION in your WIZARDS GRIMOIRE (or MANA DRAIN if needed to reach mana refund cap)
#       Then I would put remaining points into damage spells (Flamestrike, Ebolt, Mindblast, Lightning, Magic Arrow, Fireball, etc.)
#       Script displays lots of OVERHEAD MESSAGES by default - these can be changed in the variable section (minimal target indicators always remain)
#       Recommend using Razor TEXT FILTERS to cancel redundant system messages and Razor spam
#       Script has optional COOLDOWNS you can add (see list below) but they are NOT required for script function - just handy to display on bars in your U.I.
#       Script uses ORGANIZER AGENT-01 for optional MAIN INVENTORY pouch organization (can be set to auto select your main bag in inventory reset below)
#       If enabled AUTO RECALL triggers when RED is within target range or when WEIGHT LIMIT is reached in WILDERNESSMODE (optional DIY recall script usage, as well)
#       If enabled and RED is targeted in DUNGEONMODE (or WEIGHT LIMIT reached) script will use DUNGEON ESCAPE mode to locate and activate MOONGATES while keeping you alive
#       If enabled POTIONS will be automatically consumed as needed and optionally can refill pots from KEGS to reduce carry weight (and increase potion quantities)
#       If using POTION KEGS and EXPLOSION POTIONS (telekinesis spell will be used to make target sticky if Alchemy < 80) make sure to pack extra EMPTY BOTTLES
#       If enabled LOOT CHEST in your HOME/INN/BANK is used to store goods, script uses ORGANIZER AGENTS 06-09 as sub-containers you can set inside the chest to organize items further
#       If enabled and WOODEN BOX and COPPER KEY are found in inventory, loot will be automatically moved and secured when not in combat (make sure key is not inside box and well hidden)
#       If you die the DEATH LOOP will auto select moongates and travel to last gated town and then waits to auto-select the resurrection gump when a HEALER is located
#       If enabled a DRESS LIST of your [blessed] wearables will be equipped after resurrection (dress list must be named 'UltimateSummoner')
#       If enabled after resurrection script can recall home (requires scrolls in [blessed] runebook), resupply, heal, activate aspects and even set up your pack with pouch stacks, etc.
#       If enabled INVENTORY RESET will stack trapped pouches on your main inventory pouch (after putting scissors inside to protect them from shelf restocking) and then hide the stack
#       MANY FEATURES ARE TURNED 'OFF' BY DEFAULT!  MAKE SURE TO CHECK THE VARIABLE SECTION BELOW CLOSELY PRIOR TO FIRST USE!!

@setvar! EnableNecroWither 0
    # Will cast Wither prior to summoning elementals (reduces summoning mana cost)

    @setvar! EnableNecroVengefulSpirit 0
    # Vengeful Spirit will summon undead minions instead of elementals (set types/amounts above)
        @setvar! EnableNecroBloodOath 0
            # 'EnableNecroBloodOath' requires 'EnableNecroVengefulSpirit' to also be enabled (undead summons buff)

@setvar! MinimumManaAmounttoNecroBuff 20
    @setvar! EnableNecroStrangle 0
    @setvar! EnableNecroCorpseSkin 1
    @setvar! EnableNecroMindRot 1
    @setvar! EnableNecroEvilOmen 0
        # Necro buffs will be used (during combat) if Unholy Points are sufficient and minimum mana is exceeded
        # For optimum performance 'MinimumManaAmounttoNecroBuff' should be the same or higher than 'CastSmallSpellsBelowMana' (below)

@setvar! EnableNecroPainSpike 0
    @setvar! PainSpikeAttackDelay 12000
        # Adjust delay after acquiring a new target before attempting Pain Spike (to accumulate damage)
        # Increase delay if fighting tougher MOBs.
        # Timer starts when new target is attacked and delays Pain Spike (must have corpses in range to trigger)

@setvar! EnableNecroPoisonStrike 0
    # '0' for 'Disabled'
    # '1' for 'Apply after Corpse Skin disease delay timer only'
        # DO NOT USE SETTING '1' IF INTENDING TO TRIGGER FROM CAST POISON TICKS (use '2 - 9' instead!)
        # SETTING '1' IS FOR CORPSE SKIN DISEASE TRIGGERED POISON STRIKES ONLY! (set delay value below)
    # '2' for 'Apply in 2 poison ticks left or less'
    # '3' for 'Apply in 3 poison ticks left or less'
    # '4' for 'Apply in 4 poison ticks left or less'
    # '5' for 'Apply in 5 poison ticks left or less'
    # '6' for 'Apply in 6 poison ticks left or less'
    # '7' for 'Apply in 7 poison ticks left or less'
    # '8' for 'Apply in 8 poison ticks left or less'
    # '9' for 'Apply in 9 poison ticks left or less'
        # Poison Strike will be triggered by remaining Ticks (if spell poisoned) or by Corpse Skin timer (if diseased)
        # If using spell poison, use values '2 - 9' to set your Poison Strike trigger point (if sufficient Unholy Points available, etc.)
        # Poison Strike settings '2 - 9' require 'EnableCastPoison' turned on! (below)
        # If NOT using spell poison, use value '1' and set delay below (Corpse Skin must be enabled)

    @setvar! CorpseSkinPoisonStrikeDelay 15000
        # Poison Strike setting '1' requires 'EnableNecroCorpseSkin' turned on (above)
        # Setting 'CorpseSkinPoisonStrikeDelay' is the delay after casting CORPSE SKIN on NEW target before triggering POISON STRIKE
        # Increase delay value if fighting tougher MOBs

//  TARGET ATTACKING:  //
    @setvar! TargetAttackRange 12
        # Set your target auto attack range (1-12 tiles)
        # Targeted grey MOBs within this range will be engaged
        # Grey MOBs will still be targeted and analyzed outside of attack range (up to 12 tiles), but not attacked

        @setvar! CheckClosestTargetTime 2500
            # Adjust the frequency of closest target checks during combat mode (1000 - 5000ms recommended)
            # If this is set to '0' the target will remain locked until dead or out of range

//  EQUIPPED SPELLBOOK CHECK:  //
    @setvar! EnableSpellbookCheck 0
        # Use '>info' to ID any of your [blessed] spellbooks and add the serial here:
        @setvar! MyBlessedSpellbook 0x00000000
            # This will prevent the script from trying to equip it (instead of your aspect spellbook)

//  ACTIVE CROOK CHECK:  //
    @setvar! EnableAutoCrookCheck 0
        # If herding skill > 50 and crook is found, crook will be checked for activation (and activated if needed)
        # Ignores unidentified magic crooks and will activate valid crooks if found inactive
        # Activated crook will be ignored when transferring loot to lockbox (if using 'EnablePutLootinLockBox' option below)

//  OPENING SPELLS:  //
    @setvar! EnableCastCurse 0
    @setvar! EnableCastManaDrain 0
        # If enabled, Curse and/or Mana Drain will be cast on NEW targets (or every 60 seconds) before using large spells
        # Curse is highly recommended (upgrade using wizards grimoire) as well as Mana Drain (if needed to hit mana refund cap)

    # You can open with a small damage spell (ex. to apply disease) before entering main attack loops
    # Choose only 'ONE AT A TIME':
        @setvar! EnableOpenWithLightning 0
        @setvar! EnableOpenWithFireball 0
        @setvar! EnableOpenWithHarm 0
        @setvar! EnableOpenWithMagicArrow 0

//  LARGE DAMAGE SPELLS:  //
    @setvar! EnableCastFlamestrike 1
    @setvar! FlamestrikeCooldown 0
        # Flamestrike spell will be spammed repeatedly if parameters are met:
        //  Mana > 'CastMediumSpellsBelowMana' (set below), Sulfurous Ash & Spiders silk in inventory, target in attack range, and HP diff < CastGreaterHealHPdiff
        //  Recommend leaving Flamestrike cooldown at '0' unless you want to experiment


//  MEDIUM DAMAGE SPELLS:  //
    @setvar! CastMediumSpellsBelowMana 60
        # Medium damage spells will be used when mana < 'CastMediumSpellsBelowMana' but > 'CastSmallSpellsBelowMana'
        # I have found '60' for medium and '20' for small to work well but you can experiment (at your own risk)
        # Adjust your cooldowns to your preference (upgrade spells using wizards grimoire)

        @setvar! EnableCastExplosion 1
        @setvar! ExplosionCooldown 10000

        @setvar! EnableCastEnergyBolt 1
        @setvar! EnergyBoltCooldown 0

        @setvar! EnableCastMindblast 0
        @setvar! MindblastCooldown 0


//  SMALL DAMAGE SPELLS:  //
    @setvar! CastSmallSpellsBelowMana 20
        # Script will prioritize big spells (FS, xplo, ebolt, MB) above this mana value
        # Magic Arrow, Harm, Fireball and Lightning will only be cast below this point
        # Value can range from '10-110' (lower than '10' may cause errors)
        # Spell cooldown values (below) can be increased to reduce casting frequency if necessary
        # IMPT:  Upgrade spell damage using wizards grimoire

        @setvar! EnableCastMagicArrow 0
        @setvar! MagicArrowCooldown 15000

        @setvar! EnableCastHarm 0
        @setvar! HarmCooldown 15000

        @setvar! EnableCastFireball 0
        @setvar! FireballCooldown 15000

        @setvar! EnableCastLightning 0
        @setvar! LightningCooldown 15000

//  POISON SPELL:  //
    @setvar! EnableCastPoison 0
        @setvar! SetPoisonLevel 0
            # '0' for 'Greater or less'
            # '1' for 'Deadly'
            # '2' for 'Lethal'
            # Poison spell will be cast repeatedly on targeted MOB until set poison level is reached

//  MEDITATION SETTINGS:  //
    @setvar! EnableMeditation 0
        @setvar! MeditateWhenManaBelow 11
        @setvar! MeditateUntilManaReaches 50
            # If enabled, meditation will trigger if mana falls below 'MeditateWhenManaBelow'
            # Peace Mode will be activated while meditating
            # Script will resume if HP drops below 'CastGreaterHealHPdiff' (below) or if War Mode is activated
            # Otherwise, meditation ends when 'MeditateUntilManaReaches' is reached and script resumes

            while diffhits < CastGreaterHealHPdiff and find TargetToAnalyze ground -1 -1 12 and AttackModeActive = 0 and warmode and timer AnalyzeTargetTimeout < 4000
                if EnableOverheadMessages = 1 or EnableOverheadMessages = 2
                    if timer AnalyzingTargetsTimer > 10000
                        overhead '[ ANALYZING TARGET... ]' 90
                        settimer AnalyzingTargetsTimer 0
                    endif
                endif

                if dead
                    break
                endif

                if dead TargetToAnalyze or not find TargetToAnalyze ground -1 -1 12
                    @setvar! AttackModeActive 0
                    break
                endif

                if timer AnalyzeTargetTimeout > 4000
                    @setvar! AttackModeActive 0
                    break
                endif

                if EnableAutoCarving = 1 and findtype 11552 self
                    while findtype "corpse" ground -1 -1 2 as deadbody and diffhits < CastGreaterHealHPdiff
                        settimer SkinningTimeoutTimer 0
                        if findtype 11552 self
                            if targetexists
                                hotkey 'cancel current target'
                            endif

                            while not targetexists
                                skill 'forensicevaluation'
                                getlabel backpack backpacklabel
                            endwhile

                            clearsysmsg

                            if targetexists and find deadbody ground -1 -1 2
                                target 'self'
                                @ignore deadbody
                                wait 250
                            endif

                            if insysmsg "You dont see anything nearby"
                                clearsysmsg
                                break
                            else
                                if EnableOverheadMessages = 1 and timer SkinningTimer > 3000
                                    overhead '[ SKINNING... ]' 333
                                    settimer SkinningTimer 0
                                endif
                                break
                            endif
                        else
                            if EnableOverheadMessages = 1 and timer SkinningTimer > 15000
                                overhead '[ NO SKINNING KNIFE ]' 337
                                settimer SkinningTimer 0
                                break
                            endif
                        endif

                        if timer SkinningTimeoutTimer > 1500 or diffhits > CastGreaterHealHPdiff
                            break
                        endif
                    endwhile
                endif

                if find TargetToAnalyze ground -1 -1 12
                    getlabel TargetToAnalyze tempLabel

                    while "-" in tempLabel
                        getlabel TargetToAnalyze tempLabel
                    endwhile

                    if inlist animalsIgnoreList tempLabel
                        if timer "IgnoreMOBtimer" > 2500
                            if EnableOverheadMessages = 1 or EnableOverheadMessages = 2
                                overhead '[ IGNORING MOB! ]' 333 TargetToAnalyze
                            else
                                overhead " ● " 333 TargetToAnalyze
                            endif
                            getlabel backpack backpacklabel
                            settimer "IgnoreMOBtimer" 0
                            @ignore TargetToAnalyze
                        endif
                        settimer NoTargetTimer 0
                    else
                        clearsysmsg
                        skill 'begging'
                        settimer AntiStallTimer 0
                        wait 250
                        while not targetexists
                            if insysmsg 'you must wait'
                                clearsysmsg
                                skill 'begging'
                                wait 250
                            endif
                            wait 250
                            if timer AntiStallTimer > 1500
                                settimer AntiStallTimer 0
                                break
                            endif
                        endwhile

                        if targetexists
                            target TargetToAnalyze
                            getlabel backpack backpacklabel
                        endif

                        if not dead TargetToAnalyze and find TargetToAnalyze ground -1 -1 12
                            if insysmsg "cannot be seen"
                                if EnableOverheadMessages = 1 or EnableOverheadMessages = 2
                                    if timer "CannotSeeTargetTimer" > 3000
                                        overhead  '[ CANNOT SEE TARGET! ]' 44
                                        settimer "CannotSeeTargetTimer" 0
                                    endif
                                elseif timer "CannotSeeTargetTimer" > 4500
                                    overhead " ▼ " 44 TargetToAnalyze
                                    settimer "CannotSeeTargetTimer" 0
                                endif

                                settimer NoTargetTimer 0

                                if diffhits > CastGreaterHealHPdiff
                                    break
                                endif

                                clearsysmsg
                                hotkey 'target closest grey monster'
                                getlabel backpack backpacklabel
                                @setvar! TargetToCheck lasttarget

                                if insysmsg 'No one matching that'
                                    @setvar! AttackModeActive 0
                                    @setvar! TargetToAnalyze 0
                                    @setvar! TargetToCheck 0
                                    break
                                elseif TargetToCheck != TargetToAnalyze
                                    @setvar! AttackModeActive 0
                                    @setvar! TargetToAnalyze 0
                                    @setvar! TargetToCheck 0
                                    break
                                elseif find TargetToAnalyze ground -1 -1 TargetAttackRange
                                    @setvar! TargetToAnalyze lasttarget
                                    @setvar! AttackModeActive 2
                                else
                                    break
                                endif
                            elseif insysmsg "That is too far away."
                                if EnableOverheadMessages = 1 or EnableOverheadMessages = 2
                                    if timer "TargetIsTooFarTimer" > 2000
                                        overhead '[ GET CLOSER! ]' 69
                                        overhead " ▼ " 69 TargetToAnalyze
                                        settimer "TargetIsTooFarTimer" 0
                                    endif
                                elseif timer "TargetIsTooFarTimer" > 4500
                                    overhead " ▼ " 44 TargetToAnalyze
                                    settimer "TargetIsTooFarTimer" 0
                                endif
                                settimer NoTargetTimer 0
                            elseif insysmsg "Perhaps" or insysmsg "You are too far away from them." or insysmsg "They do not appear to have anything to offer you." or insysmsg "You must wait" or insysmsg "You cannot beg from an individual"
                                if find TargetToAnalyze ground -1 -1 TargetAttackRange
                                    if ClosestTarget != TargetToAnalyze
                                        settimer CurseTimer 60000
                                        settimer ManaDrainTimer 60000
                                        getlabel backpack backpacklabel
                                    endif

                                    clearsysmsg
                                    @setvar! ClosestTarget TargetToAnalyze
                                    settimer 'PainSpikeDelayTimer' 0
                                    @setvar! ClosestTargetisSticky 0

                                    say 'All kill' 2234
                                    wft 1500
                                    target ClosestTarget

                                    if timer "AttackTargetTimer" > 15000
                                        if EnableOverheadMessages != 0
                                            overhead '[ ATTACKING! ]' 69
                                        endif
                                        settimer "AttackTargetTimer" 0
                                    endif

                                    @setvar! AttackModeActive 1
                                    @setvar! NoTargetMode 0
                                    @setvar! TargetSwap 0
                                    @setvar! ClosestTargetisSticky 0
                                    @setvar! RepeatCastingPoison 1
                                    settimer PainSpikeDelayTimer 0
                                    settimer TargetChecker 0
                                    settimer NoTargetTimer 0

                                    if EnableNecroCorpseSkin = 1
                                        settimer CorpseSkinDiseaseTimer 0
                                    endif

                                    if find ClosestTarget ground -1 -1 TargetAttackRange
                                        getlabel ClosestTarget TargetDesc
                                        if EnableOverheadMessages = 1 or EnableOverheadMessages = 2
                                            if "Paragon" in TargetDesc and find ClosestTarget ground -1 -1 TargetAttackRange
                                                overhead '[ PARAGON! ]' 12 ClosestTarget
                                                overhead " ▼ " 12 ClosestTarget
                                                settimer "TargetTimer" 0
                                            elseif find ClosestTarget ground -1 -1 TargetAttackRange
                                                overhead '[ TARGET ]' 69 ClosestTarget
                                                overhead " ▼ " 69 ClosestTarget
                                                settimer "TargetTimer" 0
                                            endif
                                        else
                                            if "Paragon" in TargetDesc and find ClosestTarget ground -1 -1 TargetAttackRange
                                                overhead " ▼▼▼ " 12 ClosestTarget
                                                settimer "TargetTimer" 0
                                            elseif find ClosestTarget ground -1 -1 TargetAttackRange
                                                overhead " ▼ " 69 ClosestTarget
                                                settimer "TargetTimer" 0
                                            endif
                                        endif
                                    endif
                                    break
                                else
                                    if EnableOverheadMessages = 1 or EnableOverheadMessages = 2
                                        if timer "TargetIsTooFarTimer" > 3500
                                            overhead '[ GET CLOSER! ]' 69
                                            settimer "TargetIsTooFarTimer" 0
                                        endif
                                    elseif timer "TargetIsTooFarTimer" > 4500
                                        overhead " ▼ " 69 TargetToAnalyze
                                        settimer "TargetIsTooFarTimer" 0
                                    endif
                                    settimer NoTargetTimer 0
                                endif
                            endif
                        else
                            break
                        endif
                    endif
                else
                    @setvar! TargetToAnalyze 0
                    break
                endif

                getlabel backpack backpacklabel

                if AttackModeActive != 0
                    break
                endif

                if targetexists
                    hotkey 'cancel current target'
                endif

                if casting
                    interrupt
                endif
            endwhile

            if dead
                break
            endif
        else
            if DUNGEONMODE = 1
                @setvar! TimeToGo 1
            elseif WILDERNESSMODE = 1
                @setvar! AutoRecallTime 1
            endif
            replay
        endif
        getlabel backpack backpacklabel
    endif


    ////////////////////////

    ////////////////////////

    if dead

    endif

    if not warmode

    endif

    if EnableEatMagicMushrooms = 1

    @setvar! CastingWasInterrupted 0

    if EnableSpellbookCheck = 1 and not findtype "spellbook" hand
        if findtype "spellbook" self as mySpellbook
            for 5
            if findtype "spellbook" self as mySpellbook
                getlabel mySpellbook mySpellbooklabel

                elseif "unidentified" in mySpellbooklabel

    if EnableAutoCrookCheck = 1

            if findtype "shepherd's crook" self

                createlist CrooksToUnignore

                                overhead "[ ACTIVATING CROOK! ]" 2114

                                overhead "*crook activated*" 2114
                            endif
                            dclick myCrook

                        endif
                    endif

                endif
                endfor
                foreach CrookToUnignore in CrooksToUnignore
                    @unignore CrookToUnignore
                endfor
                removelist CrooksToUnignore
            elseif not findtype "shepherd's crook" self
                # '
                if EnableOverheadMessages != 0

                        overhead "[ NO CROOK FOUND! ]" 337
                        settimer CrookCheckOverheadTimer 0
                    endif
                endif
            endif
            settimer CrookCheckTimer 0

    endif

    @setvar! CastingWasInterrupted 0

    if TimeToGo != 1
        if EnableMagicReflection = 1 and skill 'magery' >= 70 and not findbuff "Magic Reflection" and mana >= MinimumManaToApplyMageryBuffs and diffhits < CastGreaterHealHPdiff and timer MagicReflectTimer > 15000 and findtype 3972 self and findtype 3974 self and findtype 3981 self
            if targetexists
                hotkey 'cancel current target'
            endif
            cast 'Magic Reflection'
            while not casting
                wait 250
                if insysmsg "that spell will not" or insysmsg "that spell is already" or insysmsg "You must wait"
                    settimer MagicReflectTimer 0
                    clearsysmsg
                    break
                endif
                if targetexists
                    hotkey 'cancel current target'
                endif
                cast 'Magic Reflection'
            endwhile
            while casting
                if timer MagicReflectTimer < 5000
                    break
                endif
                if diffhits >= CastGreaterHealHPdiff

                    break

                if EnableCurePotion = 1
                    while poisoned and casting and not targetexists
                        if findtype "Orange Potion" self

                                    overhead '[ CURE POTION ]' 44

                    endwhile

                if EnableHealPotion = 1 and diffhits >= HealPotionHPdiff

                            @setvar! HealPotionCheck 0

                            clearsysmsg

                            if insysmsg "potion satchel used"

                                cooldown "Healing Potion" HealingPotionCooldown

                                    overhead '[ FREE HEAL POTION ]' 253
                                endif
                            elseif HealPotionCheck != counttype 3852 self
                                settimer 'HealPotionTimer' 0
                                cooldown "Healing Potion" HealingPotionCooldown
                                if EnableOverheadMessages = 1 and timer 'HealPotionMessageTimer' > 4500
                                    overhead '[ HEAL POTION ]' 253
                                endif
                            endif
                            clearsysmsg
                        endif
                    else
                        if timer 'HealPotionMessageTimer' > 4500 and EnableOverheadMessages = 1
                            overhead '[ NO HEAL POTS! ]' 337
                            settimer 'HealPotionMessageTimer' 0
                        endif
                    endif
                endif
            endwhile
            settimer MagicReflectTimer 0
            wait 250
        endif

        if EnableReactiveArmour = 1 and skill 'magery' >= 30 and not findbuff "Reactive Armor" and mana >= MinimumManaToApplyMageryBuffs and diffhits < CastGreaterHealHPdiff and timer ReactiveArmorTimer > 15000 and findtype 3980 self and findtype 3972 self and findtype 3981 self
            if targetexists
                hotkey 'cancel current target'
            endif
            cast 'Reactive Armor'

                wait 250

                if targetexists
                    hotkey 'cancel current target'
                endif
                cast 'Reactive Armor'
            endwhile
            if timer ReactiveArmorTimer < 5000
               // Do nothing
            else
                while casting
                    wait 250
                endwhile
                settimer ReactiveArmorTimer 0

            wait 250
        endif

            if targetexists

            endif

            settimer AntiStallTimer 0
            while not casting and timer AntiStallTimer < 3500

                    settimer AntiStallTimer 0
                    break
                endif
                cast 'Arch Protection'
                wait 250
            endwhile
            while casting
                wait 250
            endwhile

            target 'self'
            wait 250
        elseif EnableProtection = 1 and skill 'magery' >= 40 and not findbuff "Protection" and mana >= MinimumManaToApplyMageryBuffs and diffhits < CastGreaterHealHPdiff and findtype 3980 self and findtype 3972 self and findtype 3973 self
            cast 'Protection'
            settimer AntiStallTimer 0

                    settimer AntiStallTimer 0
                    break

                wait 250
            endwhile

            settimer AntiStallTimer 0

                if timer AntiStallTimer > 3500
                    settimer AntiStallTimer 0

                cast 'Bless'
                wait 250
            endwhile
            while casting
                wait 250
            endwhile
            wft 1500
            target 'self'
            wait 250
        endif

    //////////////////////////

    while warmode and not dead ClosestTarget and find ClosestTarget ground -1 -1 TargetAttackRange and diffhits < CastGreaterHealHPdiff and AttackModeActive = 1
        while not warmode
            if TimeToGo = 1
                break
            else
                if WILDERNESSMODE = 1
                    if EnableAutoRedRecall = 1 or EnableAutoWeightRecall = 1
                        overhead '[ RECALLING IN... ]' 2114
                        if warmode
                            break
                        endif
                        wait 500
                        overhead "3" 69
                        wait 1000
                        if warmode
                            break
                        endif
                        overhead "2" 69
                        wait 1000
                        if warmode
                            break
                        endif
                        overhead "1" 69
                        wait 500
                        if warmode
                            break
                        else
                            @setvar! TimeToGo 1
                            @setvar! AutoRecallTime 1
                            break
                        endif
                    endif
                elseif DUNGEONMODE = 1
                    if EnableAutoRedDungeonGate = 1 or EnableAutoWeightDungeonGate = 1
                        if EnableOverheadMessages = 1 or EnableOverheadMessages = 2
                            overhead '[ DUNGEON ESCAPE! ]' 337

                        hotkey 'Toggle Peace Only'
                        @setvar! TimeToGo 1

        if not warmode and TimeToGo = 1

        if SummonEarthElemental_or_AncientMummy != 0 or SummonWaterElemental_or_RagWitch != 0 or SummonFireElemental_or_Lich != 0 or SummonAirElemental_or_SkeletalFiend != 0 or SummonDemon_or_VampireThrall != 0 or SummonCreature_or_UndeadCreature != 0
            if followers < TotalSummonCount

        if timer "TargetTimer" > 3500 and find ClosestTarget ground -1 -1 TargetAttackRange
            getlabel ClosestTarget TargetDesc
            if EnableOverheadMessages = 1 or EnableOverheadMessages = 2
                if "Paragon" in TargetDesc and find ClosestTarget ground -1 -1 TargetAttackRange
                    overhead '[ PARAGON! ]' 12 ClosestTarget
                    overhead " ▼ " 12 ClosestTarget
                    settimer "TargetTimer" 0
                elseif find ClosestTarget ground -1 -1 TargetAttackRange
                    overhead '[ TARGET ]' 253 ClosestTarget
                    overhead " ▼ " 253 ClosestTarget
                    settimer "TargetTimer" 0
                endif
            else
                if "Paragon" in TargetDesc and find ClosestTarget ground -1 -1 TargetAttackRange
                    overhead " ▼▼▼ " 12 ClosestTarget
                    settimer "TargetTimer" 0
                elseif find ClosestTarget ground -1 -1 TargetAttackRange
                    overhead " ▼ " 253 ClosestTarget
                    settimer "TargetTimer" 0

            endif

        if EnableAutoCrookCheck = 1
            if skill 'herding' > 50 and timer CrookCheckTimer > 10000
                if findtype "shepherd's crook" self
                    # '

                    createlist CrooksToUnignore
                    for 5
                    if findtype "shepherd's crook" self as myCrook
                        # '
                        getlabel myCrook crooklabel
                        wait 250
                        if 'activated' in crooklabel
                            break
                        elseif 'unidentified' in crooklabel
                            pushlist CrooksToUnignore myCrook
                            @ignore myCrook
                        else
                            if followers > 0
                                if EnableOverheadMessages = 1
                                    overhead "[ ACTIVATING CROOK! ]" 2114
                                else

                                endif
                                dclick myCrook
                                wait 250
                                break
                            endif
                        endif
                        wait 250

                    endfor

                    endfor

                elseif not findtype "shepherd's crook" self
                    # '
                    if EnableOverheadMessages != 0
                        if timer CrookCheckOverheadTimer > 15000
                            overhead "[ NO CROOK FOUND! ]" 337
                            settimer CrookCheckOverheadTimer 0
                        endif
                    endif
                endif
                settimer CrookCheckTimer 0

        if EnableStrengthPotion = 1 and diffhits < CastGreaterHealHPdiff
            if skill 'Alchemy' > 0 and skill 'Alchemy' < 2

                            if insysmsg "potion satchel used"
                                overhead '[ FREE STRENGTH POTION ]' 956

                                overhead '[ STRENGTH POTION ]' 956
                            endif
                            clearsysmsg

                        if timer WhitePotionMessageTimer > 4500
                            overhead '[ NO STRENGTH POTS! ]' 337
                            settimer WhitePotionMessageTimer 0

            elseif skill 'Alchemy' = 0
                if insysmsg "You may now use a strength" or not findbuff "Strength Potion Usage Cooldown"
                    if findtype "White Potion" self
                        dclicktype "White Potion"
                        if EnableOverheadMessages = 1 and timer WhitePotionMessageTimer > 4500
                            if insysmsg "potion satchel used"
                                overhead '[ FREE STRENGTH POTION ]' 956
                            else
                                overhead '[ STRENGTH POTION ]' 956
                            endif
                            clearsysmsg
                            settimer WhitePotionMessageTimer 0

                        wait 250

                        if timer WhitePotionMessageTimer > 4500
                            overhead '[ NO STRENGTH POTS! ]' 337
                            settimer WhitePotionMessageTimer 0

                endif
            else
                if not findbuff "Strength"

                            if insysmsg "potion satchel used"

            if findtype "Yellow Potion" self as HealPot
                getlabel HealPot HealPotlabel
                if "next" in HealPotlabel

                    dclicktype 3852
                    getlabel backpack backpackdesc

                        if EnableOverheadMessages = 1 and timer 'YellowPotionMessageTimer' > 4500
                            overhead '[ FREE HEAL POTION ]' 253
                        endif

                        settimer 'HealPotionTimer' 0
                        cooldown "Healing Potion" HealingPotionCooldown
                        if EnableOverheadMessages = 1 and timer 'YellowPotionMessageTimer' > 4500
                            overhead '[ HEAL POTION ]' 253

                    endif
                    clearsysmsg
                endif
            else
                if timer 'YellowPotionMessageTimer' > 4500 and EnableOverheadMessages = 1
                    overhead '[ NO HEAL POTS! ]' 337
                    settimer 'YellowPotionMessageTimer' 0
                endif
            endif

            else

                    settimer BluePotionMessageTimer 0

        endif

        if EnableMagicResistPotion = 1 and not findbuff "Magic Resist" and diffhits < CastGreaterHealHPdiff
            if findtype "Black Potion" self
                dclicktype "Black Potion"

                @setvar! missingGreaterHealRegs 1
                getlabel backpack backpacklabel
            else
                @setvar! missingGreaterHealRegs 0
            endif

            if not findtype 3972 self or not findtype 3973 self or not findtype 3974 self
                @setvar! missingHealRegs 1
                getlabel backpack backpacklabel
            else
                @setvar! missingHealRegs 0
            endif

            if missingGreaterHealRegs = 1 or missingHealRegs = 1
                if timer NoHealRegsTimer > 4000
                    overhead '[ MISSING HEALING REGS! ]' 337
                    settimer NoHealRegsTimer 0
                endif
            endif

            @setvar! SpellInterrupted 0
            clearsysmsg

            if skill 'magery' >= 60 and diffhits >= CastGreaterHealHPdiff and diffhits <= CastHealHPdiff and mana >= 11 and EnableCastGreaterHeal = 1 and not casting and missingGreaterHealRegs != 1
                say 'All guard me' 2234
                @setvar! SpellInterrupted 0
                cast 'greater heal'
                getlabel backpack backpacklabel
                settimer spellTimer 0
                @setvar! spellCD 2500
                while not targetexists and timer spellTimer < spellCD
                    if insysmsg "Your concentration is disturbed"
                        interrupt
                        @setvar! SpellInterrupted 1
                        break
                    endif
                    if timer spellTimer > spellCD
                        break
                    endif
                endwhile
                if SpellInterrupted = 0
                    target 'self'
                endif
            elseif skill 'magery' >= 40 and diffhits >= CastHealHPdiff and diffhits < CastEmergencyHealHPdiff and mana >= 4 and EnableCastHeal = 1 and not casting and missingHealRegs != 1
                say 'All guard me' 2234
                @setvar! SpellInterrupted 0
                cast 'heal'
                getlabel backpack backpacklabel
                settimer AntiStallTimer 0
                while not targetexists and timer AntiStallTimer < 1500
                    if insysmsg "Your concentration is disturbed"
                        interrupt
                        @setvar! SpellInterrupted 1
                        break
                    endif
                    if timer AntiStallTimer > 1500
                        settimer AntiStallTimer 0
                        break
                    endif
                endwhile
                if SpellInterrupted = 0
                    target 'self'
                endif
            elseif skill 'magery' >= 40 and diffhits >= CastEmergencyHealHPdiff and mana >= 4 and EnableCastHeal = 1 and not casting and missingHealRegs != 1
                say 'All guard me' 2234
                while diffhits > CastGreaterHealHPdiff and mana >= 4 and findtype 3972 self and findtype 3973 self and findtype 3974 self and not dead
                    if targetexists
                        hotkey 'Cancel current target'
                    endif
                    @setvar! SpellInterrupted 0
                    cast 'heal'
                    getlabel backpack backpacklabel
                    settimer AntiStallTimer 0
                    while not targetexists and timer AntiStallTimer < 1500
                        if insysmsg "Your concentration is disturbed"
                            interrupt
                            @setvar! SpellInterrupted 1
                            break
                        endif
                        if timer AntiStallTimer > 1500
                            settimer AntiStallTimer 0
                            break
                        endif
                    endwhile
                    if SpellInterrupted = 0
                        target 'self'
                        getlabel backpack backpacklabel
                    endif
                    if diffhits <= CastGreaterHealHPdiff
                        break
                    endif
                endwhile
            endif

            @setvar! SpellInterrupted 0

            if paralyzed and EnableAutoParalyzePouch = 1
                say 'All guard me' 2234
                if findtype "pouch" self
                    yell "[pouch"
                    wait 250
                else
                    if timer PopPouchMessageTimer > 5000 and EnableOverheadMessages = 1
                        overhead '[ NO MORE POUCHES! ]' 337
                        settimer PopPouchMessageTimer 0
                    endif
                endif
            endif

            if EnablePanaceaPotion = 1 and skill 'Alchemy' >= 80
                if findbuff "Bleed" or findbuff "Diseased"
                    if not findbuff "panacea potion cooldown"
                        if findtype "Orange Potion" self
                            dclicktype "Orange Potion"
                            wait 250
                            if findbuff "panacea potion cooldown" and EnableOverheadMessages = 1
                                overhead '[ PANACEA ACTIVATED ]' 55
                                cooldown "Panacea Potion" 30000
                            endif
                        endif
                    endif
                endif
            endif

            if EnableCleansingBrews = 1
                if findbuff "Diseased" or findbuff "Bleed"
                    if timer CleansingBrewTimer > 120000
                        if findtype 50675 self 2935 as CleansingBrew
                            dclick CleansingBrew
                            if EnableOverheadMessages = 1
                                overhead '[ CLEANSING BREW ]' 2117
                            endif
                            cooldown 'Cleansing Brew' 120000
                            settimer CleansingBrewTimer 0
                            wait 250
                        else
                            if timer CleansingBrewOverhead > 15000
                                overhead "[ NO CLEANSING BREWS! ]" 337
                                settimer CleansingBrewOverhead 0
                                settimer CleansingBrewTimer 0
                            endif
                        endif
                    else
                        if EnableOverheadMessages = 1 and timer CleansingBrewOverhead > 15000
                            overhead '[ BREW ON COOLDOWN! ]' 37
                            settimer CleansingBrewOverhead 0
                        endif
                    endif
                endif
            endif

            if EnableCurePotion = 1 or EnableCastCure = 1
                while poisoned
                    if findtype "Orange Potion" self and EnableCurePotion = 1
                        dclicktype "Orange Potion"
                        if EnableOverheadMessages = 1 and timer 'CurePotionMessageTimer' > 3500
                            if insysmsg "potion satchel used"
                                overhead '[ FREE CURE POTION ]' 44
                            else
                                overhead '[ CURE POTION ]' 44
                            endif
                            clearsysmsg
                            settimer 'CurePotionMessageTimer' 0
                        endif
                        wait 500
                    else
                        if timer 'CurePotionMessageTimer' > 5000 and EnableOverheadMessages = 1
                            overhead '[ NO CURE POTS! ]' 337
                            settimer 'CurePotionMessageTimer' 0
                        endif
                        if diffhits >= 30 or not findtype 3972 self or not findtype 3973 self
                            break
                        endif
                        if skill 'magery' >= 40 and mana >= 6 and EnableCastCure = 1 and not casting
                            cast 'cure'
                            getlabel backpack backpacklabel
                            settimer AntiStallTimer 0
                            while not targetexists and timer AntiStallTimer < 1500
                                if timer AntiStallTimer > 1500
                                    settimer AntiStallTimer 0
                                    break
                                endif
                                wait 100
                            endwhile
                            wft 1000
                            target 'self'
                            wait 500
                        else
                            break
                        endif
                    endif
                endwhile
            endif

            if targetexists
                if findtype " Elven Spellblade" self
                    targettype "Elven Spellblade"
                else
                    target backpack
                endif
            endif

            clearsysmsg
            hotkey 'target closest grey monster'
            wait 250
            @setvar! TargetToAnalyze lasttarget

            if insysmsg 'No one matching that'
                @setvar! AttackModeActive 0
                @setvar! TargetToAnalyze 0
            else
                @setvar! TargetToAnalyze lasttarget
                @setvar! AttackModeActive 2
            endif
        endif
    endif

    if dead
        break
    endif
endwhile

//////////////////////
//  END ALIVE LOOP  //
//////////////////////


/////////////////////////
//  BEGIN DEATH LOOP:  //
/////////////////////////

if dead
    if EnableOverheadMessages = 1 or EnableOverheadMessages = 2
        overhead '[ R.I.P. ]' 337
    endif
    wait 1500

    while dead
        @setvar! IHAVEDIED 1
        wait 500
        if timer "WaitingForHealerTimer" > 4000
            overhead '[ FIND A HEALER! ]' 0
            settimer "WaitingForHealerTimer" 0
        endif

        if findtype "blue moongate|30528|moongate" ground -1 -1 15 as EscapeGate
            if timer "GateIndicatorTimer" > 2000
                overhead " ▼ " 253 EscapeGate
                settimer "GateIndicatorTimer" 0
            endif
        endif

        while not gumpexists 3773199800 and findtype "blue moongate|30528|moongate" ground 0 1 2 as EscapeGate
            dclick EscapeGate
            wait 500
        endwhile

        while gumpexists 3773199800
            gumpresponse 16
            wait 500
            waitforgump 3773199800
            gumpresponse 2
            overhead '[ GATING TO TOWN... ]' 88
            break
        endwhile

        while gumpexists 2957810225
            overhead '[ HEALED! ]' 84
            gumpresponse 1
            wait 1000
            gumpclose 2957810225

            if EnableDressAfterResurrection = 1
                overhead '[ DRESSING... ]' 22
                wait 500
                dress 'UltimateSummoner'
                wait 500
                while queued
                    wait 100
                endwhile
                dress 'UltimateSummoner'
                wait 500
                while queued
                    wait 100
                endwhile
                dress 'UltimateSummoner'
                wait 500
            endif

            if EnableRecallAfterResurrection = 1
                hotkey 'Toggle Peace Only'
                @setvar! ResThenTimeToGo 1
                wait 500
                replay
            else
                wait 2500
                overhead '[ STOPPING SCRIPT! ]' 88
                stop
            endif
        endwhile
    endwhile
endif

replay

//////////////////////
//  END DEATH LOOP  //
//////////////////////

scripts.title: Magery One Button Hotkey
scripts.description:
Set the variables as desired. 1 = yes, 0 = no.

This will cast Reactive Armor if it's needed. It can also cast Leyline if you want. It will also use cure potion, heal potion if needed. You'll need to set a 5 second Leyline cooldown so that it doesn't just constantly turn it on and off. It will then cast Flamestrike until you are below 60 mana, then it will cast Magic Arrow, Harm, Fireball, Lightning if they are off cooldown. Otherwise it will cast Flamestrike until below 40 mana, then Mind Blast.

You will need to have my other healing script in order for it to heal and you will need to copy the same cooldown names for this to work fully.
scripts.author: jolanar#0
scripts.code:
#Wizard Grimoire
@setvar! castArrow 0
@setvar! castHarm 0
@setvar! castFireball 0
@setvar! castLightning 1
@setvar! castProtection 1

#Potions

@setvar! useStrengthPotion 1
@setvar! useDexterityPotion 1
@setvar! useResistPotion 1
@setvar! useStaminaPotion 1
